//: Story Phase 11 crew dialogue: bedtime inside the storm (hammocks, the lamp, Brogath), the Cheap-O-Rama sashes and the pocket edition, the sash-flutter weakness (three weeks), and the conspiracy, ready.
pete.p11_ready_1: pete[annoyed]: (whispering) I'll gasp, Captain. I'll gasp like I've never gasped. I've been practising in my head.
pete.p11_weakness_1: pete[happy]: (quietly) Three weeks, Captain. I keep saying it to myself. Three. Weeks.
pete.p11_weakness_2: pete: He's lying very still up there. That's a man who knows he's said too much.
pete.p11_sashes_1: pete[annoyed]: 'Ages six and up.' He's been wearing a toy, Captain. For MONTHS. He made us SALUTE it.
pete.p11_sashes_2: pete[tired]: I'm sleeping in a bed sash. I'd like it entered in the log that I'm sleeping in a bed sash under protest.
pete.p11_bedtime_1: pete[tired]: (from the hammock) Captain. Hypothetically. If a man's been made Grand Sharkmaster against his will, can he resign?
pete[tired]: Then how do I RESIGN, Captain?
pete.p11_bedtime_2: pete[annoyed]: Six ropes. For a lamp. And the worst part is I'm going to sleep better because of it.
bob.p11_ready_1: bob: (whispering) 'Dice are for little Stenchmasters.' I'm going to say it in a voice. I've got a voice for it.
bob.p11_weakness_1: bob: Is it bad for him? The flapping?
captain: It's the WORST thing for him, Bob.
bob.p11_sashes_1: bob[happy]: I pulled the tab on mine, Captain. PRRRBBT. I've pulled it eleven times.
bob.p11_sashes_2: bob: The cardboard sash holders are smiling, Captain. Why are they smiling? What do they know?
bob.p11_bedtime_1: bob[happy]: (from the hammock) It's like being a sandwich, Captain. A swinging sandwich.
bob: Sandwiches don't sleep, Captain. They wait.
bob.p11_bedtime_2: bob: Captain? If Brogath was so shy, how does anybody know about him?
captain: That is the best question anyone's asked all month, Bob.
gristle.p11_ready_1: gristle: (whispering) Thirty seconds, Captain. Behind him. I've done some hard things at sea. I wouldn't do that.
gristle.p11_weakness_1: gristle: First time in a month I've seen you smile, Captain. It's frightening. Keep doing it.
gristle.p11_sashes_1: gristle: Won't tear. Won't fray. Won't burn, probably. If they weren't covered in noses they'd be the best cloth on the ship.
gristle.p11_sashes_2: gristle[annoyed]: Three hundred boxes. Where are we going to KEEP three hundred boxes?
gristle.p11_bedtime_1: gristle: (from his sack) That sailcloth's been next to the sauce vats. I don't trust it. I don't trust anything that's been next to the sauce vats.
gristle.p11_bedtime_2: gristle: Good rigging, that lamp. I'll say it once and then I'll never say it again.
jim.p11_ready_1: jim: (whispering) No beans in the morning. Not one. If he's going to be loaded, he's going to be loaded on his own time.
jim.p11_weakness_1: jim[happy]: Three weeks of cooking FOOD, Captain. Real food. With things in it that aren't beans.
jim.p11_weakness_2: jim: Twenty-one days with no beans in the pot for HIM. I'll make bread. I'll make bread every day.
jim.p11_sashes_1: jim[annoyed]: He wants the playsets 'kept somewhere clean'. My galley is the only clean place on this ship. My galley is now a WAREHOUSE.
jim.p11_sashes_2: jim: Repair sash. That's all it is. A REPAIR sash. Don't let him tell you it's anything else.
jim.p11_bedtime_1: jim[annoyed]: (from the hammock) Somebody's been at my bootlaces.
jim[annoyed]: The LAMP has my BOOTLACES?
jim.p11_bedtime_2: jim: I'm going to cook something tomorrow that isn't beans. I don't know what. I'm going to find it.
ned.p11_ready_1: ned: (whispering) I'll point. I'm a good pointer. I was lookout for six years.
ned.p11_weakness_1: ned: Three weeks is a long time at sea, Captain. Long enough to sail somewhere. Anywhere. Somewhere that isn't THIS.
ned.p11_sashes_1: ned: A flying machine, Captain. With a WINDMILL on top. In a storm. Delivering toys. To the fart man.
ned: I'm just saying it out loud so I know I said it.
ned.p11_bedtime_1: ned: (from his sack) I saw a shark go past the porthole reading a newspaper, Captain. I'm not going to say anything else about it.
ned.p11_bedtime_2: ned: We pass the same lobster every forty seconds. Pete timed it. I checked. Thirty-nine.
rusty_tom.p11_ready_1: rusty_tom[alarmed]: (whispering) You're going to hold it YOURSELF? Captain. Captain, you don't know what it's like back there.
rusty_tom.p11_asleep: rusty_tom: (asleep) ...not letting go... not letting go...
rusty_tom.p11_weakness_1: rusty_tom: If the sash is supposed to flutter... then nobody needs to hold it. Is that right? Is that what it means?
rusty_tom.p11_sashes_1: rusty_tom[alarmed]: Two cardboard sash holders in every box. That's six hundred sash holders, Captain. Does that mean they don't need ME?
rusty_tom[happy]: ...Best news I've had all voyage.
rusty_tom.p11_bedtime_1: rusty_tom[coughing]: Please don't make me hold anything tonight, Captain. I can still feel it in my arms.
rusty_tom.p11_bedtime_2: rusty_tom: I volunteered once, Captain. ONCE. It's following me round like a dog.
barnacle_bill.p11_ready_1: barnacle_bill: (whispering) I'll point at it. Don't make me touch it.
barnacle_bill.p11_weakness_1: barnacle_bill: Gasp and point. That's a job I can do. That's a ceremonial role I'll take.
barnacle_bill.p11_sashes_1: barnacle_bill: I'm not holding one of THOSE either. Toy or no toy.
barnacle_bill.p11_bedtime_1: barnacle_bill: Not related to Bob. Still not. Don't put me on any charts, Captain.
barnacle_bill.p11_bedtime_2: barnacle_bill: Finger-Puller. I saw him look at me. I'm too old to be looked at like that.
hale.p11_ready: hale: Going to be a big morning, I hear. I hear everything up here. The wind carries it.
hale.p11_weakness: hale: Something's cheered you up, Captain. I won't ask. I'm a first mate. I've learned not to ask.
hale.p11_sashes: hale: A flying machine came by while you were below. Very polite. Lowered a crate and went. I didn't wave.
hale.p11_bedtime: hale: (on deck, at the helm) She steers like a cork in a bucket, Captain. I'm keeping her pointed at nothing in particular.
nell.p11: nell: We heard the sacks go, Captain. All the way down here. Sounded like a landslide of potatoes.
sully.p11: sully: The hold's holding, Captain. Mostly. Everything's tied down that can be tied down.
fennimore.p11: fennimore: Is it true he's got a lamp on SIX ropes up there? We've got a candle in a boot.
wick.p11: wick: Something keeps tapping on the hull. I think it's a shark. I think it's knocking.
rook.p11: rook: I don't want to know what's going on up in the galley, Captain. I'm happy not knowing.
brask.p11: brask: Tokens coming down the hold hatch too. 'WHY DOES A PIRATE SHIP HAVE A DESIGNATED FART MAN?' Fair question.
jory.p11: jory: Can't sleep. Every time I close my eyes the hold goes round.
finch.p11: finch: Somebody said there's toy sashes. Is there one going spare? Asking for my hammock.
mags.p11: mags: I'm knitting a hat for the lamp, Captain. To cheer it up.
quill.p11: quill: I'm writing all this down for the log. I'm running out of words that mean 'fart'.
penhallow.p11: penhallow: The treasure room door's got a sign on it now. Gristle's handwriting. DO NOT OPEN. Shakier than usual.
garrick.p11_weakness_1: garrick[nervous]: It's an ANECDOTE, Captain. Gustavio. It doesn't apply. It's not a rule. There's no rule.
garrick.p11_weakness_2: garrick[nervous]: Why does everybody keep smiling at me?
garrick.p11_sashes_1: garrick[proud]: Educational reproductions, Captain. For the young. Every great faith has a gift shop.
garrick.p11_sashes_2: garrick[offended]: You're lying on regalia, Captain.
captain: I'm lying on a bed sash.
garrick[offended]: You're lying on a bed sash made of REGALIA.
garrick.p11_bedtime_1: garrick[delighted]: (from the hammock) Isn't this COSY, Captain? A storm outside, a lamp inside, a legend on the way.
garrick.p11_bedtime_2: garrick[proud]: The Grand Bedside Illumination System, Captain. Six anchor points. Brogath had eight. I'm working up to it.
squawks.p11_bedtime_2: squawks[smug]: Bedtime story. Bed. Time. Story. Pick one.
